project_name: Adwa Lens — AI-Powered WebAR Museum Companion

features.name: Design System Tokens & CSS Utilities
features.description: Establish Imperial Gold, Adwa Emerald, Adwa Crimson, Obsidian, Wanza Wood, and Parchment design system tokens in Tailwind & index.css.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 1 'Design System' & docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Stream C Phase 1
verification_criteria: Tailwind config exports all custom color tokens
No raw hex colors used in component styling

features.name: Central Session & Exhibit State Stores
features.description: Implement Zustand state stores for user session, party type, persona selection, itinerary, visited exhibit IDs, and network status.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 1.1 'App State Manager' & docs/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md Rule 1
verification_criteria: Zustand store manages persona (kids|scholar|royal), itinerary array, and visited exhibit IDs
resetSession resets store cleanly

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Fastify BFF Gateway Proxy & Error Handling
features.description: Build Fastify server gateway with CORS, environment variable API keys, and error normalization middleware.
verification_criteria: Fastify listens on port 8787 with CORS enabled
/api/health endpoint returns status ok
Errors are normalized via normalizeError

features.name: Exhibit Metadata Schemas & Catalog Definitions
features.description: Create strict metadata JSON definitions for all 5 catalog exhibits: shotel_sword, menelik_taytu_statue, negarit_drum, embilta, and meleket.
features.spec_reference: docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Section 1 'Complete Artifact Roster' & docs/GOVERNANCE.md Section 4
verification_criteria: All 5 exhibit JSON files contain valid exhibit_id, glb_url, hotspot_json, persona_scripts, and audio_profile fields

features.name: Hero Artifact 3D Model Asset (Shotel Sword)
features.description: Source/author hero Shotel curved sword .glb with Draco compression, KTX2 textures, and camera default framing.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 1.2 Step 4 & docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Stream A Phase 1
verification_criteria: shotel_sword.glb loads progressively in model-viewer without console errors

features.name: Landing Screen & Onboarding Permission Priming Modal
features.description: Build full-bleed landing screen with hero video/model loop, English, Amharic, and supported foreign languages (e.g., Spanish) language toggle, and soft in-app permission priming modal.
verification_criteria: Landing screen renders Start My Tour CTA and language selector (EN, AM, ES)
Switching language alters UI text and Voice AI system prompt/TTS language parameters cleanly without runtime audio stream errors
Permission priming modal triggers before browser media permission dialogs

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash Vision Proxy & Camera Heuristic Gate
features.description: Implement /api/vision-scan Fastify proxy forcing strict JSON catalog match, plus client-side brightness/blur pre-scan checks in useCameraScanner.js.
verification_criteria: Camera scanner sends base64 frame to Fastify vision proxy
Gemini response parses exhibit_id and confidence score
Low light / blur triggers UI hints before calling API

features.name: 3D WebGL Inspection Hub with Dynamic Hotspots
features.description: Build InspectionHub.jsx using model-viewer/Three.js with auto-rotate handoff, pinch-zoom orbit, and multi-tab hotspot drawer.
verification_criteria: InspectionHub displays 3D model with interactive hotspot pins
Tapping hotspot opens Material | Craft | Usage drawer tabs

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Voice Guide RAG Pipeline (Kids Persona MVP)
features.description: Implement Groq Whisper STT -> Groq Llama 3.3 70B RAG -> ElevenLabs TTS pipeline with browser speechSynthesis fallback for Kids Explorer persona.
verification_criteria: Mic input transcribes text via Whisper STT route
Llama RAG generates persona-conditioned answer streaming to TTS
Browser speechSynthesis fires if ElevenLabs fails

features.name: Negarit Drum Direct Mesh Tap, Strike Button & Haptics
features.description: Build Negarit Drum interactive audio mechanics: direct 3D mesh raycast tap, Strike UI mallet button, Web Audio synth tones, and navigator.vibrate haptic sync.
verification_criteria: Tapping drum mesh or clicking Strike button plays Web Audio drum tone
Hit triggers navigator.vibrate pulse and visual audio-wave canvas animation

features.name: Post-Tour Memory Deck Recap & Visited Exhibit Shelf
features.description: Build MemoryDeck.jsx displaying recap cards for visited exhibits, AR snapshot thumbnails, and digital badge shelf.
verification_criteria: Memory Deck lists visited exhibits populated from useSessionStore
Share / export button triggers card preview

features.name: Adaptive Itinerary Planner Wizard & Crowd Feed
features.description: Build card-stack wizard with time budget, interest chips, party type, accessibility options, and route generator with simulated crowd density.
verification_criteria: Wizard choices update session store partyType, timeBudgetMinutes, and interests
Generates multi-stop itinerary card list

features.name: Indoor 2D SVG Map & Live Route Navigation
features.description: Build LiveNavigation.jsx top-down 2D SVG floor map with color-coded walking route line, crowd warning chip, and manual 'I am here' checkpoint check-in.
verification_criteria: SVG map renders user location dot and route path
Tapping 'I am here' updates current stop index in session store

features.name: Hero Artifact 3D Exploded View Transformation
features.description: Implement GSAP transform tween / morph targets separating shotel_sword.glb into blade, hilt, and sheath layers upon button toggle.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 2 'Screen 5' & docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Stream A Phase 2
verification_criteria: Tapping Exploded View toggle animates mesh node separation with text labels

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Multi-Persona Engine (Scholar & Royal) & Mid-Tour Switch
features.description: Expand persona engine with History Scholar and Royal Roleplay prompts in personas.js and UI persona switcher chips in VoiceGuideOverlay.jsx.
verification_criteria: Switching avatar chip immediately alters system prompt tone and TTS voice ID

features.name: Embilta & Meleket Blowing Mechanics & Airflow Overlay
features.description: Build wind instrument blowing interaction: mic breath autocorrelation pitch/amplitude detection in pitchDetection.js, interactive Blow button, and visual airflow particle shader.
verification_criteria: Blowing into mic or clicking Blow button sounds ceremonial tone for Embilta and Meleket
Triggers glowing airflow particle overlay on 3D instrument model

features.name: Blade Swipe Clash SFX & Particle Canvas Burst
features.description: Implement touch swipe gesture across crossed Shotel blade models triggering metallic clash sample and lightweight canvas spark particle burst.
verification_criteria: Swiping across blades triggers metallic clash audio and spark particle burst animation

features.name: Interactive Quiz Engine & Digital Badge Unlock
features.description: Build multiple-choice quiz engine (3-5 questions on visited exhibits) and digital badge unlock logic integrated into MemoryDeck.jsx.
verification_criteria: Quiz generates questions dynamically from visited exhibit IDs
Correct answers unlock digital badges on badge shelf

features.name: Emperor Menelik II & Empress Taytu Monument 3D Asset & Hotspots
features.description: Integrate menelik_taytu_statue.glb model with multi-hotspot annotations for Velvet Kaba, Crown, Weaponry, and Taytu Banner.
verification_criteria: Monument 3D model loads and displays all 4 royal hotspot pins with content drawers

features.name: Embilta & Meleket Instrument 3D Models Integration
features.description: Integrate embilta.glb and meleket.glb models into InspectionHub and SensoryHub with blowhole and mouthpiece hotspot pins.
verification_criteria: Embilta and Meleket models load in 3D canvas with active sensory mode triggers

features.name: Low-End Device 3D LOD & Pre-rendered Fallback
features.description: Add low-poly LOD variant loading and non-WebGL2 image sequence fallback for older mobile browsers.
verification_criteria: WebGL failure gracefully displays pre-rendered layer image sequence fallback

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Offline Service Worker & Top-20 Exhibit Pre-Cache
features.description: Build Service Worker caching top 20 exhibit JSON files, static persona scripts, and browser speechSynthesis offline fallback.
verification_criteria: Disconnecting network serves pre-cached exhibit JSON and static persona scripts

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: AI Prompt Safety Guardrails & Off-Topic Redirection
features.description: Implement prompt guardrails in backend/lib/personas.js politely redirecting off-topic or inappropriate user questions back to exhibit context.
verification_criteria: Off-topic question triggers polite in-character persona redirection to museum topics

features.name: Accessibility & Ergonomics Pass
features.description: Perform WCAG contrast check, thumb-reachable CTA layout optimization, and sticky voice avatar captions overlay.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 2 Screen 7 & docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Stream C Phase 3
verification_criteria: Text passes contrast ratio checks and voice captions remain visible in sound-off mode

features.name: End-to-End Demo Path Validation & Rehearsal Pipeline
features.description: Validate unbroken execution of the complete 8-screen hero demo path per hackathon judging narrative arc.
verification_criteria: Full demo flow runs smoothly: Landing -> Planner -> LiveNav -> CameraScan -> InspectionHub -> VoiceGuide -> SensoryHub -> MemoryDeck
